List of reportedly haunted locations
This is a list of locations that are (or have been) said to be haunted by
ghosts
,
demons
, or other
supernatural
beings throughout the world. Reports of haunted locations are part of
ghostlore
, which is a form of
folklore
and
witchcraft
.
